messages:
maria: Quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2142 to address a few style nits that CI flagged. It's mostly identifier casing and a leftover trailing comma in proto -> small changes.

maria: Tests pass locally but CI is failing the linter step. I can push a follow-up with fixes if someone can review quickly. Planning to merge once two approvals + green CI. :clock1:

sam: I can take the review today. If it's just casing and commas I can batch the fixes and squash. Ping me when you push the follow-up. :thumbsup:

lee: Quick question — for the `request_id` fields, are we standardizing on snake_case in protos or camelCase in Go structs? I remember we had a short doc but can't find it.

arjun: For protos we tend to use snake_case in the .proto and camelCase in Go after generation. If the PR is changing generated fields, prefer updating the proto and regenerating. If it's only internal variable names, prefer Go-style `requestID`.

maria: Thanks — this PR touches the user-visible proto field names in `lightweight.proto` (line ~120). I kept the proto as-is, the lint was from a Go var `request_id` in handler.go. I'll change it to `requestID` and run `buf generate` if needed.

ci-bot: ci/lint — Failed on commit 9f3a2b1: golangci-lint: identifier `request_id` should be `requestID` (gocamelcase) — see https://ci.redwood/proj/2142/logs

sam: Perfect. Once you push the rename and a tiny changelog note I'm happy to approve. Do you want me to merge or do you need a specific merge window?

maria: I can push the rename in a follow-up commit in ~30m. No hard merge window — will wait for your approval and green CI. I'll also add a one-line entry to CHANGELOG.md under 'internal'.

lee: If you want me to eyeball the proto regen step after, happy to do a quick pass. Otherwise good to go.

maria: Awesome — pushing now. Thanks everyone :rocket:
